name: Free Shipping Bar
summary: Passive target-controlled free-shipping message composed with the determinate Bar profile of canonical Progress.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive grouping for the target message and canonical Progress composition.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Complete localized below-threshold or achieved message.

anatomy.name: progress
anatomy.description: Determinate Bar profile of canonical Progress with a required accessible name.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Canonical Progress track; Free Shipping Bar does not duplicate its implementation.

anatomy.name: bar
anatomy.description: Canonical Progress bar projected from the clamped target range.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One neutral free-shipping composition; Progress shape, tone, and motion are not K5 options.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic block composition that consumes its parent inline size.

states.name: default
states.description: Current qualifying value is below the target-owned threshold.

states.name: achieved
states.description: Derived when the clamped current value reaches max; the complete message must state eligibility.

behavior.name: canonicalDeterminateProgress
behavior.description: Composes canonical determinate Progress, rejects a non-positive max, and clamps visual and accessible current values together to zero through max.

behavior.name: derivedThresholdState
behavior.description: Achieved state is derived from value greater than or equal to max; no independent boolean can contradict the range.

behavior.name: targetAnnouncementBoundary
behavior.description: K5 is not a live region; the cart target announces only meaningful authoritative eligibility transitions outside the component.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Required non-empty complete localized below-threshold or achieved message.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Required non-empty localized accessible name for the canonical progressbar.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Finite target-owned qualifying amount projected and clamped to the determinate range.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Finite positive target-owned free-shipping threshold in the same unit as value.

properties.name: valueText
properties.description: Optional localized human-readable interpretation of the raw determinate value, especially for money-like progress.

accessibility: Require a localized accessible name and keep aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, optional aria-valuetext, and visual width synchronized.
Use complete visible text for below-threshold and achieved meaning; do not rely on width, color, or emphasis alone.
Keep the component passive and non-focusable; it has no keyboard or pointer interaction.
Do not make K5 a live region. Announce meaningful authoritative eligibility transitions once from the target cart status policy.
Inherit canonical Progress reduced-motion and forced-colors behavior.

web.notes: Passive message composition using the determinate Bar profile from canonical Progress.

shopify.notes: Parameter-driven translation only; merchant/product policy must choose qualifying amount, threshold, placement, refresh, message, and announcement behavior.
